subject: Audit period inclusivity & migration rollforward — clarify snapshot timestamps
messages:
From: Ellen Ruiz <ellen.ruiz@acmecloud.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarification request — SOC 2 Type II coverage timestamps and Apr 1 migration

Hi Aisha,

Hope you're well. We're preparing the Type II evidence package for Acme Cloud and have two related clarifications for Redwood's environment that will affect the documentation we request from our auditors: 

1) End-of-day inclusivity: your SOC 2 period is listed as "through March 31, 2028." For our evidence sampling we need to know whether "through March 31" should be interpreted as inclusive of events that occur at 23:59:59 local time on March 31, or if your policy treats the day as ending at 00:00:00 on April 1 (i.e., are events timestamped exactly at midnight included?). Please specify the timezone you are using for this boundary (UTC vs local region).

2) Planned DB migration on Apr 1: Acme noted a planned maintenance/migration starting 00:30 on Apr 1 PDT that will cut and replay a replica. Will Redwood consider a bridge letter to characterize the post-cutover state and replication lag for the first 12 hours after migration? If so, what metrics and snapshots can you provide (replica lag, sequence numbers, last known as-of snapshot timestamp)?

If possible, please attach the manifest that lists the as-of snapshots you will provide and any standard language you use in bridge letters so we can align with our auditors. I've attached our standard Audit_Request_Form.pdf for reference.

Thanks — we need this clarified before we lock the sampling window later today.

Best,
Ellen Ruiz
Senior IT Audit Manager
Acme Cloud
E: ellen.ruiz@acmecloud.com
A: AuditOps <auditops@acmecloud.com>

Attachment: Audit_Request_Form.pdf

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Ruiz <ellen.ruiz@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarification request — SOC 2 Type II coverage timestamps and Apr 1 migration

Ellen — thanks for the clear questions. Quick answers up front, followed by details.

Summary:
- Redwood defines audit-period boundaries in UTC and treats the end date as inclusive up to 23:59:59.999 UTC on the listed final day.
- We will produce an as-of snapshot manifest with the EOD snapshot timestamp marked in UTC (file: end_of_day_snapshot_manifest.csv).
- For the Apr 1 migration we will provide a bridge letter that documents the cutover window and replication metrics (replica lag, last-committed-LSN, and a short timeline). We can include the first 12 hours of replication metrics and the as-of snapshots immediately before and after cutover.

Details:
1) Timezone and inclusivity
- Our compliance tooling normalizes event timestamps to UTC for SOC 2 evidence. For a period "through March 31, 2028," the inclusive window includes events with event_time <= 2028-04-01T00:00:00.000Z (i.e., up to 23:59:59.999 on March 31 UTC).
- If you require evidence in PDT (your local time), we can provide a mapping table, but primary artifacts will cite UTC as the authoritative boundary.

2) Migration and bridge letter scope
- The planned DB migration on Apr 1 at 00:30 PDT (07:30 UTC) is outside the Type II period end. That said, standard practice for our customers is to issue a bridge letter describing: the nature of the migration, the exact cutover timestamp in UTC, replication lag sampling for the first 12 hours, and any data replays or backfills.
- We will prepare a bridge_letter_draft.docx that contains: cutover timestamp (UTC), affected services, pre/post snapshot LSNs (last-committed-LSN), and a 12-hour replication-lag CSV extract. We will also include a short statement on why the cutover does not change controls in effect during the covered period.

3) Evidence we will attach to the audit package
- end_of_day_snapshot_manifest.csv (includes snapshot_id, as_of_utc, storage_path)
- replication_lag_12h_<migration-id>.csv (post-cutover — provided for the bridge letter only)
- system_event_logs_sample_20280331.zip (redacted event logs for sampling — will provide hashes only in the manifest)

Next steps:
- I'll attach the snapshot manifest and a first-pass bridge letter draft by EOD (I will include Marissa and David for verification).
- If Acme's auditors prefer East/West timezone mappings we can annotate the manifest with PDT offsets.

—Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0172

Attachment: end_of_day_snapshot_manifest.csv

Thanks Aisha — that helps a lot. Two quick follow-ups: 

1) Can you confirm the UTC boundary statement in plain language for our engagement letter? I want a single sentence we can paste: e.g., "The audit period ending March 31, 2028 includes events timestamped up to 23:59:59.999 UTC on 2028-03-31."

2) For the bridge letter, would you be able to provide the first-pass draft by 17:00 PDT so we can circulate to our auditors before close of business PST? If that's tight, please let me know the latest you can commit.

If you can attach the manifest and the one-line UTC sentence in your reply that will be perfect.

Appreciate it — Ellen
